dict.string: Flyd uses Accessibility only when invoked so it can understand the focused app, field, and nearby context.
Flyd uses Apple Events only when needed to understand or act in the app you invoke it from.
Flyd uses the microphone only when you start voice input.
Flyd uses Input Monitoring only to hear the Control + Option shortcut.
Flyd captures the screen only when you invoke it and app context is not enough.
